messages.subject: Computational complexity of Stan
parts:
Hi all,

I was wondering if there's a simple way to determine the computational complexity for stan as a function of the number of parameters? If needed, I can post my code.

Thanks,

Daniel

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Computational complexity of Stan
parts:
Not really. You'll find some rough order-of-magnitude arguments
in Radford Neal's overview of HMC, but it's not helpful in practice and
isn't for NUTS, which has different properties. The posterior geometry
impacts the constant factors, which will dominate computation time.

- Bob
